childNodes.name: Daybreak Point - Ideal

Now, we stand on the very same ground as those heroes.

childNodes.name: Daybreak Point - Sense
childNodes.description:
The Interlocking Security Competition is one of the few events where Minos allows the Infected to compete in.
During it, such competing athletes are permitted only to spend their free time within competition bounds.
It is forbidden to leave the grounds without having obtained permission, on threat of coercive measures.

childNodes.name: Daybreak Point - Attribute
childNodes.description:
'You didn't know? Not long ago, the 'Goddess of Victory' emerged from nowhere, guiding the Minoans to repel those ferocious Sargon invaders...' 
'The 'Goddess of Victory' showed up, brought victory to the Minoans, and then simply left without a word. Such a missed opportunity... if her feats were formally recorded in the Hall of the Twelve Heroes, she would've been conferred great hero status, no doubt! And now all that's left for us is the legend to tell.'

childNodes.name: Daytime Ground - Conduct
childNodes.description:
This is the Garrison Team's first time splitting with the squad. Be alert for anything.
If you want to challenge the mighty OpFor on the Twilight Frontier, then you need to send a team to garrison here. Withdrawal from here means losing your right to challenge that one additional OpFor Unit.
Calm down. Think slowly. Rational personnel planning will reward you with greater points for an utmost advantage.
<@lv.rem><Command Terminal></>Deducts 1 Life Point if destroyed

<@tu.ht>Garrison Effect: <Hymnoi Hero> will proceed to the Twilight Frontier</>

<@tu.ht>Garrison Effect: <Hymnoi Warrior> will proceed to the Twilight Frontier</>

childNodes.name: Wildland Outpost
childNodes.description: This place used to be one of our outposts on the edge of the barrens. Time, beasts, and scavengers have taken their toll, but it is a good starting point for a factory base that can support further expansion into the wildland.

childNodes.name: Ruined City
childNodes.description:
We found a scrapped plate of unknown affiliation. The marks of battle upon it show the reason it was abandoned. Exercise caution, as there may be more than meets the eye within.

<@level.highlight>[Rich Vein]</>Deploy a [Surveyor] on it to turn it into an [Originium Mine] that produces [Packaged Cores].

childNodes.name: Wailing Canyon
childNodes.description:
We found a canyon with roaring winds. The good news is that the area is rich in resources. The bad news is that the resources seem to have been placed there by someone, and that someone is after us.

<@level.highlight>[Ruins]</>When destroyed, turns its own tile into an [Outpost] (deployable for high ground units), with a chance to drop a Basic Armory Plug-in.
<@level.highlight>[Rich Vein]</>Deploy a [Surveyor] on it to turn it into an [Originium Mine] that produces [Packaged Cores]

childNodes.name: Collapsed Mines
childNodes.description:
We found a devastated mine. The trail of human remains extends from the collapsed tunnels all the way to the surface. It was no mundane mine accident that destroyed this place, and horror stories about shambling wanderers continue to be told.

<@level.highlight>[Rich Vein]</>Deploy a [Surveyor] on it to turn it into an [Originium Mine] that produces [Packaged Cores]

childNodes.name: Sedimentary Riverbed
childNodes.description:
We found a riverbed with a heavy sediment layer. The salt grains in the mud indicate that seawater was once present in the river. There may be more than just resources buried within the sediment.

<@level.highlight>[Rich Vein]</>Deploy a [Surveyor] on it to turn it into an [Originium Mine] that produces [Packaged Cores]

childNodes.name: Kaleidoscopic Nest
childNodes.description:
We found a colorful nest belonging to some kind of creature. Samples indicate that the colors are produced by an unusual scale powder, but the creature it came from does not appear in any known records. Its behavior and threat level are unknown at this time.

<@level.highlight>[Rich Vein]</>Deploy a [Surveyor] on it to turn it into an [Originium Mine] that produces [Packaged Cores]

childNodes.name: Bone-Strewn Wilds
childNodes.description:
We found a wasteland littered with carcasses. This place is undoubtedly ruled by an apex predator. The abnormally high levels of Originium activity signify danger, but also the potential for rich Originium deposits.

<@level.highlight>[Rich Vein]</>Deploy a [Surveyor] on it to turn it into an [Originium Mine] that produces [Packaged Cores]
<@level.highlight>[Active Originium]</>Operators deployed on it and enemies who have passed it will take constant damage, but their ATK and ASPD will be increased significantly.

childNodes.name: Treacherous Karst
childNodes.description: A treacherous environment filled with karsts and deep valleys. We would not tread here unless absolutely necessary. From above, it seems there are only a few stone columns strong enough to provide steady footing. Be careful about what's under your feet.

childNodes.name: Treacherous Ditches
childNodes.description: A treacherous environment where the ground is full of ditches. We would not tread here unless absolutely necessary. Sharp claws have left their mark on the ground, perhaps trying to dig something up—or keep it hidden.

childNodes.name: Treacherous Pass
childNodes.description: A treacherous environment with tall peaks surrounding a pass. We would not tread here unless absolutely necessary. Common sense indicates that this place is easy to defend and hard to attack, but there are many around these parts who do not operate according to common sense.

childNodes.name: Treacherous Cliffs
childNodes.description: A treacherous environment where the mountains are separated by sheer cliffs. We would not tread here unless absolutely necessary. The winding mountains beyond the cliffs have created a maze. What you believe to be the sound of thunder could very well be caused by falling rocks.

childNodes.name: Treacherous Caverns
childNodes.description: A treacherous environment of winding caves. We would not tread here unless absolutely necessary. The tunnel walls carry the sound of small critters moving as a pack, and there is rot and decay in the air.

childNodes.name: Treacherous Spires
childNodes.description: A treacherous environment of rock formations corroded by wind and sand. We would not tread here unless absolutely necessary. This place lacks many of the conditions necessary for life, but the bleached bones and blood trails demonstrate that life has established its own form of order in this place of death.

childNodes.name: Treacherous City
childNodes.description: A treacherous miasma-filled city ruin. We would not tread here unless absolutely necessary. Catastrophe has caused these broken walls and roads to fade from the memories of those who built them, and a curse has befallen this place. The ruined city is a deadly trap, and we find ourselves in its presence.

childNodes.name: Treacherous Lake
childNodes.description: A treacherous, dried, collapsed lake bed. We would not tread here unless absolutely necessary. An enormous concrete dome is hidden beneath the bottom of the lake. An explosion of unknown cause has turned this heavily guarded base into a slaughter ground where it is every survivor for themselves, and deadly weapons unbound by rule or reason are now pointed at us.

childNodes.name: 躁动冲刺
childNodes.description: 有些事情发展起来就会变成这样——看上去有点机会，急匆匆冲过去却发现根本来不及。

childNodes.name: 慧眼如炬
childNodes.description: 很多时候精心策划的战术就是会被一眼看穿，没办法，只能说努力过了。

childNodes.name: 南辕北辙
childNodes.description: 明明想走向目的地，最后却发现自己越走离目标越远，这样的迷失并不少见。

childNodes.name: 刺骨苦难
childNodes.description: 这种攻击方式看起来很吓人，实际上也很痛苦，而且对战斗双方来说都是如此。

childNodes.name: 速递怪谈
childNodes.description: 偶尔有些信件会拖很久才能送到，派送方究竟把它们运到哪里去了？

childNodes.name: 向死而生
childNodes.description: 勇气不是决定一位战士能否胜任的唯一要素，但总归是一个要素。

childNodes.name: 狭岸相逢
childNodes.description: 无赖们学会两路包夹战术确实令人头疼，在敌人合流之前将他们逐个击破吧！

childNodes.name: 过度狂热
childNodes.description: 换作别的场合可能会有人建议为了自身安全不要挡路，不过看看周围，眼下似乎无法采纳这个提议。

childNodes.name: 水土不服
childNodes.description: 无论能不能适应，总得找到适合自己的位置。

childNodes.name: 殊途同归
childNodes.description: 话虽这么说，但选好了要走的路可别后悔，犹犹豫豫的话会得不偿失哦。

childNodes.name: 夺命光影
childNodes.description: 炫目的亮光可以是希望的象征，也可以是毁灭的前兆。

childNodes.name: 掌声之外
childNodes.description: 演出谢幕的方式，不会写在任何一张节目单上。\n<@lv.item><弩炮台></>会定期射出弩箭对我方单位造成物理伤害

childNodes.name: 新风向
childNodes.description: 风向改变时总是悄无声息，直到所有旗帜都指向同一个方向，人们才后知后觉。

childNodes.name: 授信之人
childNodes.description: 他站在天平的另一端，同样是风险的承担者。他深知，信任不只是出现在赌桌上的筹码。

childNodes.name: “卡托加区欢迎你”
childNodes.description: 我向你转述一个支离的夜晚，青春在雪地里熄灭，朽木在壁炉中苟延残喘。

childNodes.name: 卑劣与繁荣
childNodes.description:
我向你献上一座锈蚀的地块，这里曾是圣骏堡喘鸣不止的工业肺脏，但现在，它只是一个等待被切除的器官。
<@lv.item><警戒塔></>定期旋转，同时攻击范围内所有暴露的我方单位
<@lv.item><伪装工具></>使被影响的单位潜伏一段时间，其间无法被选中也不会阻挡敌人
<@lv.item><禁闭所></>仅能被周围四格的干员攻击，破坏后获得伪装工具与部署费用并吸引附近的警戒塔

childNodes.name: 枷锁之中
childNodes.description: 我向你追偿一笔陈旧的血债，你鞭打驱赶那些被编号的兽群，任由他们哭号怒骂，直到他们想起自己曾为人类。\n<@lv.item><警戒塔></>定期旋转，同时攻击范围内所有暴露的我方单位\n<@lv.item><伪装工具></>使被影响的单位潜伏一段时间，其间无法被选中也不会阻挡敌人

childNodes.name: 阳光照耀圣骏堡
childNodes.description: 我向你乞求一个清朗的夜晚，只需要一点星火，就足以点燃这片干枯而痛苦、渴望着新生的土地。\n<@lv.item><警戒塔></>定期旋转，同时攻击范围内所有暴露的我方单位\n<@lv.item><伪装工具></>使被影响的单位潜伏一段时间，其间无法被选中也不会阻挡敌人

childNodes.name: 一墙之隔
childNodes.description: 我向你虚构一段精密的舞步，自出生起就被赐下的脚镣是我转圜的支点，我背向烛光以看清围墙另一边的黑夜。\n<@lv.item><警戒塔></>定期旋转，同时攻击范围内所有暴露的我方单位\n<@lv.item><伪装工具></>使被影响的单位潜伏一段时间，其间无法被选中也不会阻挡敌人

childNodes.description:
我向你坦白一桩必要的僭越，我保留了我所有的意见，因为那高举的天平不再称得出真与假的分别。
<@lv.item><警戒塔></>定期旋转，同时攻击范围内所有暴露的我方单位

childNodes.name: 各自流亡
childNodes.description:
我向你描摹一条拥挤的道路，那些匆匆的脚步只是恰巧相逢在同一条路上。没人能知道到底谁才是正确的，每个人都只能沿着自己的命运流亡。
<@lv.item><警戒塔></>定期旋转，同时攻击范围内所有暴露的我方单位

childNodes.description:
我向你展示一个牢固的死结，我和你是这根绳的两端，中间横亘着北方的冻土和涅瓦湖干涸的河道，但那难以逃脱的宿命仍将我向你怀中拽去。

childNodes.operation: 轮换图 熔炉检修口

childNodes.description:
Annihilate the large number of Reunion mobs in Chernobog. Watch out for the leaders patrolling the area.
<@lv.rem><Special Conditions></> DP will not regenerate naturally.

Annihilate the dangerous Reunion mobs lurking in the outskirts of Lungmen, and ensure that no threat is posed to the safety of the city.
<@lv.rem><Special Conditions></> DP will not regenerate naturally.

Annihilate the Reunion armed forces that have invaded Lungmen, and regain initiative within the region.
<@lv.rem><Special Conditions></> DP will not regenerate naturally.

childNodes.operation: Kazimierz The Grand Knight Territory Outskirts
childNodes.description:
A large-scale competitive exhibition game organized by the Kazimierz General Chamber of Commerce. As a defender, Rhodes Island must make use of sponsor drones to deal with the Knightclubs' elites.
<@lv.rem><Special Conditions></> DP will not regenerate naturally.

Well-organized Reunion guerrillas are hiding in this abandoned nomadic city in the tundra of Ursus. Be prepared for the deathly chill, as that is your only hope for victory.
<@lv.rem><Special Conditions></> DP will not regenerate naturally.

A remote mine in Ursus where the Infected Patrol Unit are hunting down the Infected. Make good use of the tricky terrain to buy time for the Infected to escape.
<@lv.rem><Special Conditions></> DP will not regenerate naturally and failing to save an Ursus civilian will result in a penalty of -1 annihilation count.

An unassuming beach on the coastline of Siesta currently overrun by Sicilians and rioters. Utilize the Command Terminals provided by the city of Siesta and apprehend them posthaste.
<@lv.rem><Special Conditions></> DP will not regenerate naturally.

As the tides surge, the Seaborn grow restless deep within a vast cavern. With the help of the remaining Iberian machines there, eliminate the Seaborn threat once and for all.
<@lv.rem><Special Conditions></> DP will not regenerate naturally

After the 'Watchtower 33' incident, some 'Redmark' mercenaries avoided Rhodes Island's pursuit while controlling the remnant Originiutant mutants. If these organisms are allowed to escape to other areas, the outcome would be disastrous. Please carry out a thorough extermination.
<@lv.rem><Special Conditions></> DP will not regenerate naturally
<@lv.item><Sandstorm></> Allied units caught inside the sandstorm will have reduced ATK, continuously take damage over time, and have extended redeployment time; Enemy units will instead be slowed

Lady Candela recently invested in two Leithanian 'Gramophones.' She hopes that Rhodes Island will participate in a joint exercise with the Dossoles Defense Squad to test out the point-defense capabilities of the 'Gramophones.'
<@lv.rem><Special Conditions></> DP will not regenerate naturally.
<@lv.item><'Gramophone'></> Both allied and enemy units will fight for control over this device; When activated, deals Arts damage to enemies and heals allies.

The convict Jesselton, having been transferred from Mansfield State Prison, has incited a prison riot, aided by the local Siracusan gangs who decided to join in. Rhodes Island must intervene immediately and put down the insurrection using the Imprisonment Devices. 
<@lv.rem><Special Conditions></>DP will not regenerate naturally.
<@lv.item><Imprisonment Device></>Imprisons freed enemies within its effect area.

After accepting a commission from Victoria, Rhodes Island sets out to deal with Spectre Force active in the County Hillock countryside.
<@lv.rem><Condition></> DP will not regenerate naturally.
<@lv.item><Tattered Pillar> </>Can be knocked down by neighboring Operators, dealing True damage to the two tiles it falls on and forming rubble that blocks routes.

A corporation in Kazimierz is planning an unusual game show. Participants must fend off wave after wave of knight attacks in order to claim the grand prize. Rhodes Island has been invited as a contestant. 
<@lv.rem><Special Conditions></> DP will not regenerate naturally. 
<@lv.item><City Neon></> Provides an initial amount of visibility, and can further increase visibility when used

Wares of all shapes and sizes have once again appeared on the twisting mountain paths. Are they seeking the goblet which once granted them sentience, which was subsequently cast from the mountains? The relevant bureaus in Yan have requested Rhodes Island's assistance in this matter.
<@lv.rem><Special Conditions></>DP will not regenerate naturally.

The Summit of Nations is over, and Pathfinders that have not left with the Guide remain in Laterano, trying to restore faith there in their own way. They have caused a disturbance in the commercial area of the Stevonus district, and the Notarial Hall has requested help from Rhodes Island.
<@lv.rem><Special Condition></>DP will not regenerate naturally.
<@lv.item><'Gelato Stop'></>Both allied and enemy units will fight for control over this device; When activated, restores SP of surrounding allies

The shipyard that built ships such as the Stultifera Navis has become a nest of Sea Terrors. The Inquisition has contracted Rhodes Island to eliminate them in order to salvage a Golden Age ship-of-the line that is still restorable.
<@lv.rem><Condition></> DP will not regenerate naturally.
<@lv.item><Hand of the Saint - Purification Mode></> Bounces a 'Hand of the Saint' in the deployed direction, stunning and dealing damage to enemies it collides with, and clearing Nethersea Brand in its path.

The prototype power armors stored in Test Site 359's hanger have suddenly reactivated during the cleanup work. The Rhodes Island operators present must quickly intervene and bring this incident to a close.
<@lv.rem><Special Conditions></>DP will not regenerate naturally.
<@lv.item><R-Series Power Armor></>Absorbs nearby experimental products to recover SP. Activates when SP is full.

At the behest of the Rat King, the local Siracusan mafia contacted a number of mercenaries, preparing to bring joy to the city during Sauin. But before they do so, they need to rehearse with Rhodes Island's operators to ensure no civilians are harmed. 
<@lv.rem><Condition></> DP will not regenerate naturally.
<@lv.item><Mobile Tactical Hangar> </>Deploys drones as needed to assist enemy combatants. 
<@lv.rem><Command Terminal> </>Depletes 1 Life Points when destroyed.

A renowned musician is holding a charity concert, but intel indicates that troublemakers have infiltrated the audience, disguised as the Witch King's Remains. Operators are to act promptly to ensure that the concert is held smoothly.
<@lv.rem><Condition> </>DP will not regenerate naturally.
<@lv.item><Waste Energy Interference> </>Natural SP recovery rate reduced.
<@lv.item><Realigned Flux> </>Restores natural SP recovery rate of allied Operators within.

With the flame called resentment cast into those overgrown reeds, the ashes quickly make their pursuit of those trekking through their homeland. Having heard their pleas for help, Rhodes Island will not stand idly by.
<@lv.rem><Special Conditions></>DP will not regenerate naturally.
<@lv.item><Mire></>Gradually reduces the ASPD of Operators within, and the ASPD and Movement Speed of enemies within.
<@lv.item><Reeds></>Operators within gain Camouflage.

The Durins who miss 'The Great Aquapit' so much have constructed new aquatic amusement facilities on the surface. All the tribes of Acahualla have received invitations to join the carnival, and crates of alcoholic beverages are being delivered...Rhodes Island, please, lend a hand in maintaining order!
<@lv.rem><Special Condition></>DP will not regenerate naturally.

The armies of the Nachzehrer ravage the fields, turning fertile farmland to barren wastes. Send a squad to repel them, and give a sliver of hope to the people of Londinium, who have suffered for too long.
<@lv.rem><Condition></> DP will not regenerate naturally.
<@lv.item><Twigs That Crave></> Produces Rot Eaters when destroyed or at the end of the stage.

Roaming bandits have come together again, planning an attack on a weakly defended mountain pass. 
<@lv.rem><Condition> </>DP will not regenerate naturally.
<@lv.item><Yumen Catastrophe Defenses> </>Units placed here deal more damage to low ground units and take less damage from low ground units.
<@lv.item><Defensive Barricade> </>Blocks multiple enemies.

Tourists never stay here, but they do leave with its song and wine. They even want to take with them those soft and fluffy dreams, but those have already melted away in yesterday's evening breeze. Do you see those fluffy creatures? Let's chase after them together, one more time.
<@lv.rem><Condition></>DP will not regenerate naturally
<@lv.item><Decorative Geyser></>Units standing around it are unaffected by vapor, and will produce White Vapor when attacking
<@lv.item><Steam Soda Bottles></>When defeated, creates Pure White Steam in the surrounding area

Gravity, visibility, trajectory. An arclight builds a bridge at the crossroads of fate, within the erratic everything. Somewhere not far from the land, we shall overcome cowardice and hubris together. We remember, we hold fast, we advance without looking to the past.
<@lv.rem><Special Conditions></> DP will not regenerate naturally
<@lv.item><Gravity Switch></> Gravity Switches and Planetary Debris: Moves along a set path, blocking lanes and dealing physical damage to units they touch. Can be moved by your units in adjacent tiles.

This is not only their war, but ours too! Taking back Londinium means taking back every room, street, and neighborhood in our memories. Forward, forward!
<@lv.rem><Condition></> DP will not regenerate naturally.
<@lv.item><Londinium Secondary Defense Artillery> </>Once fully charged, deals area True damage to both allies and enemies, centered on the friendly unit with the highest Block.

Blizzards, heaters, and frost-covered burdenbeasts. Rhodes Island, a delegation, and the snowy valleys of Kjerag. Those who couldn't get their fill of excitement on the frozen lake have gathered in a secluded spot for a fierce showdown. Unfortunately, they've disturbed the peaceful slumber of the burdenbeasts.
<@lv.rem><Condition></> DP will not regenerate naturally.
<@lv.item><Emergency Heater></> Makes surrounding Operators immune to the Frigid environmental effect.

A cityway that once carried pioneers and hope as it stretched further and further west. Once. Now, the promises of the past have faded. The facilities once full of promise have fallen into disrepair, leaving only an invitation echoing over the airwaves: to clear out enemies.
<@lv.rem><Special Conditions> </>DP will not regenerate naturally
<@lv.item><Waste Heat Vent> </>Deals Arts damage to both enemies and allies and reduces enemies' Movement Speed, but will charge their energy.

These hundred mu of fragrant fields and paddies are also the hope of farmers who dream of a future without famine. Vermin encroach once more, and blight has begun to pollute the crops. We ask Rhodes Island for aid in protecting the harvests of these hard-working farmers!
<@lv.rem><Special Condition> DP will not regenerate naturally.</>
<@lv.item><Farmland> </>Operators on Farmland recover HP or take damage based on Blight level.

The 'Echoes of Herkunftshorn'—they seek to carry on the Witch King's melody. Play now, rescue team from Rhodes Island; drown out the chaotic, resentful, and paranoid notes with your own melody. The Kurfürstenplatz should witness the most beautiful sunset.
<@lv.rem><Special Condition>DP will not regenerate naturally.</>
<@lv.item><Tuning Node></>Heals when attacked; when activated during a song variation, changes the variation and briefly applies a buff to friendly units.

Brazen sand bandits have accidentally awakened the sleeping exhibits while trying to rob the museum. Restore order to the streets!
<@lv.rem><Special Conditions></> DP will not regenerate naturally.

A caravan searching for artifacts from the Golden Age has accidentally stumbled upon a saltfin nest. The vicious saltfins have them pinned down in the Salt Flat, while dastardly pirates are closing in on them with their salt ships. They've been sending distress signals to Rhodes Island the entire time, so go and save them already!
<@lv.rem><Special Condition></> DP will not regenerate naturally.
<@lv.item><Salt Flat></> Enemies passing through have reduced Movement Speed; after stopping for long enough, they will sink in and be defeated
<@lv.item><Saltheap Cannon></> Periodically fires a shell forward, dealing Physical splash damage; can launch a nearby ground enemy of 3 Weight or less to the center of the explosion

实验室投放的信标侦测到了紊乱的洋流，海嗣正从巢穴中蔓延而出，逐渐将整片海盆淹没。潜入幽邃的深渊，矫正这股暗流吧！
<@lv.rem><特殊条件></>部署费用不会自然回复
<@lv.item><赘生甲壳></>可部署高台干员
<@lv.item><航道信标></>需要高台单位充能；开启后使我方单位获得灼燃损伤能力
<@lv.item><小帮手></>可清除<赘生甲壳>和<溟痕>

childNodes.operation: 卡兹戴尔 炽灼车间
childNodes.description: 散发着灼人热浪的熔炼车间里涌入了大量极端分子，他们正在工厂中肆意破坏，一旦放任设施被毁后果将不堪设想。突破热能的阻隔，让车间恢复正常运转吧！\n<@lv.rem><特殊条件></>部署费用不会自然回复\n<@lv.item><接驳地块></>初始不可部署干员，需要周围存在其他干员进行协助

桌上的老窖散发香气，锅中的菜肴聚集精华，然而被美味吸引过来的不只是客人，还有一群可怖的造物。阻止它们闯进后厨，守住这道人间烟火吧！
<@lv.rem><特殊条件></>部署费用不会自然回复
<@lv.item><火灶></>召唤“人间烟火”对沿途所有敌方单位造成真实伤害。
<@lv.item><废弃火灶></>召唤“饮露餐风”对所有沿途我方单位造成真实伤害。

圣堂之外一片安宁，但这并不意味着和平。改写未来的生命正在巨构中孕育，被赐福的存在将遍布整片大地。在那所谓的福祉降临世间之前，停下这场终将抵达静滞的朝圣！
<@lv.rem><特殊条件></>部署费用不会自然回复
<@lv.rem><入梦砖></>置于其中的干员会立刻被拖入美梦中
<@lv.item><扮演者></>叫醒后以各种方式协助战斗
